snippet.title: 妖怪俱乐部 Demon Club // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/992620/_Demon_Club/

Realizing the dream of being a demon king in childhood "Demon Club" is a game based on chinese mythology. It is envisioned on an overhead continent called "ShenZhou". The player is a demon with no power.

Developed by
chenjd
